hebrewText: צִמְּתַ֥תְ/נִי קִנְאָתִ֑/י כִּֽי שָׁכְח֖וּ דְבָרֶ֣י/ךָ צָרָֽ/י

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed

a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
